verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt index at docs.mesh.complyadvantage.com/llms.txt. Doc pages are served as markdown with `agentTools.projectIndex` frontmatter pointing back to that index, and an unauthenticated OpenAPI 3.0.3 schema is retrievable, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt/agent-docs offering, and evidence of an expanded full-content variant (e.g. llms-full.txt).
